meta.title: Vendor modifies the counter offer — buyer QCS shows modified tag and new value
gaps: Vendor modifies the pending counter offer to ₹85 and submits a remark explaining the adjustment.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Vendor modifies the pending counter offer to ₹85 and submits a remark explaining the adjustment.

steps.note: Create the RFQ event used for the counter-offer flow.
Provide the required event title.
Configure the event as an RFQ so the QCS and counter-offer flow apply.
Apply the RFQ pricing template before adding line items.
Add one product for the bid and counter offer.
Complete the RFQ pricing sheet.
Commit a bidding schedule before publishing.
Invite the QA vendor who will submit the original bid.
Publish the RFQ so the vendor can bid.
Confirm the event reached a real published project page.
Submit the vendor's original bid of ₹90.
Confirm the vendor bid was accepted.
Open the buyer's QCS before sending the counter offer.
Send the buyer's counter offer of ₹80 against the vendor bid.
Confirm the counter offer is pending for the vendor.

args.need: sign in as the vendor, modify the pending counter offer to ₹85, enter a remark explaining the adjustment, and submit it

steps.note: The catalog has no vendor action for modifying a pending counter offer with a remark.
Return to the buyer session after the vendor modification.
Reopen the buyer's QCS on the RFQ tab to inspect the modified bid.
Assert the vendor's modified RFQ value is ₹85.
Assert the modified counter-offer status tag is shown.
Assert the vendor's submitted remark is visible in the QCS.
